summary: Backend-only iteration 5. Wrote 25 new pytest cases at /app/backend/tests/test_email_auth.py covering email/password sign-up + sign-in, forgot/reset password, the Apple App Review seed account, and a regression sweep over phone-OTP, /auth/me, admin login, admin-only guards on /admin/users and /admin/payments, /events, /applications and the real-Razorpay /payments/create-order. ALL 25/25 PASSED. Verified: (1) POST /api/auth/register with {name,email,password,phone,city} → 200, returns token+user with auth_provider='email', role='participant', verified=false, phone & city echoed; duplicate email and duplicate phone both correctly return 400; minimal register without phone/city also works. (2) POST /api/auth/login: success with the registered user; wrong password → 401; unknown email → 401. (3) Apple Review seed login appreview@aleeclub.com / AleeReview@2026 → 200 with role='participant' and verified=true; /auth/me works with that JWT. (4) POST /api/auth/forgot-password: known email returns sent:true with an 8-char UPPERCASE-HEX reset_token; unknown email correctly returns sent:true with reset_token:null (privacy — does not leak existence; intentional per spec). (5) POST /api/auth/reset-password: new_password <6 chars → 400; wrong reset_token → 400; correct token+new_password → 200, immediate login with new password works; reusing the same token → 400 'used'. Test restores the documented Apple Review password at the end so the seed credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md remain valid. (6) Regression: /auth/phone/start + verify with +919999777666 and OTP 123456 → 200 token/user; /auth/me with phone JWT → 200; admin login → 200 role='admin'; /admin/users and /admin/payments → 200 for admin and 403 for non-admin phone user; /events ≥ 1 item; /applications (reused existing for phone user) and /payments/create-order returns mock=false with a real Razorpay order_id beginning 'order_'. No 500s in backend logs throughout the run.

minor.issue: FastAPI HTTPBearer default returns 403 instead of 401 for missing token (carry-over from earlier iterations; functionally correct).

action_items: None blocking. Optional: in production, gate the forgot-password response so reset_token is NEVER returned (only emailed). Currently surfaced for MVP — this is documented and acceptable for now.
Optional: add rate-limit on /auth/forgot-password to prevent token flooding for known emails.

Optional: server.py forgot-password reset_token uses uuid.uuid4().hex[:8] — 8 hex chars = 32 bits of entropy. Adequate for MVP, but a 6-digit OTP via email or a longer token (16+ chars) would be stronger for production.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:343-384 — /auth/register correctly forces role to 'participant' when client sends 'admin' (prevents self-elevation), hashes via bcrypt, and strips password_hash + _id from response.

server.py:387-396 — /auth/login uses constant-time-ish bcrypt.checkpw and returns a single 401 'Invalid email or password' for both unknown-email and wrong-password cases. Good (no user-enumeration via login).

server.py:399-422 — /auth/forgot-password intentionally returns sent:true with reset_token:null for unknown emails to prevent enumeration. The token is also logged at INFO level — fine for MVP but should be downgraded to DEBUG once email delivery is wired up.

server.py:425-438 — /auth/reset-password validates min-length (≥6), looks up by (email, token, used:false), then marks used:true atomically. Token reuse and wrong token both → 400. No leakage of which side (email vs token) failed.
server.py:1224-1256 — Apple App Review seed upserts on startup and refreshes the password if it drifts, mirroring the admin-seed behaviour. Good idempotency.
server.py models: RegisterReq uses EmailStr (rejects reserved TLDs like .test) — keep this in mind for test-data; production-safe.

success_rate.frontend: not tested this iteration (backend-only request per main agent)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Public base URL: https://glamour-audition.preview.emergentagent.com. All new email-auth endpoints (/auth/register, /auth/login, /auth/forgot-password, /auth/reset-password) are green; the Apple App Review seed user (appreview@aleeclub.com / AleeReview@2026) is seeded and pre-verified on startup, with role='participant'. The test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_email_auth.py is idempotent and re-runnable — it restores the Apple Review password at the end. Razorpay test keys still return real order_ids with mock=false. forgot-password reset_token is intentionally returned in the response for MVP and intentionally returns reset_token:null for unknown emails — do NOT flag either as a bug.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no blocking issues found. All 25 tests passed on first full run after a single test-data fix (EmailStr rejects '.test' TLD → switched to '@example.com' / '@example.org').
